description_en: Modifies the description of a database account
description_zh: 修改数据库账号的备注信息
name: ModifyAccountDescription

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query instance IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in the specified region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The modified account description. The description must meet the following requirements:

It must start with a letter or a Chinese character.
It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
It can contain letters, Chinese characters, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and digits.
It must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
指定修改后的账号描述，要求如下：

以中文、英文字母开头。
不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
可以包含中文、英文字符、“_”、“ -”、数字。
长度为2~256个字符
parameters.name: account_description

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure idempotence. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327176.html
parameters.help_zh: 幂等性校验。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327176.html
parameters.name: client_token
